findingsResolved: Removed hardcoded hosted account defaults from the migrated transport path; explicit new variables take precedence while serving legacy configuration remains compatible.
Browser and server SDKs share a fixed local-migration cookie name despite different internal/public transport hosts.

Public compatibility transport exposes fixed operations and the parameterless boolean liveness RPC only, with DTO/header allowlists, bounded requests, canonical origin checks, finite errors and no automatic mutation replay.
Browser OAuth/email GET navigation can enter without an API-key header, while user/admin boundaries remain enforced; callback errors are sanitized and provider destinations fixed.
Local Auth retains verification, provider credentials and source password/session policy; unlimited hosted durations are omitted rather than translated to zero-second GoTrue expiry.
Auth uses its dedicated trusted database search path; synthetic cleanup uses soft deletion instead of weakening immutable account-link retention.
Native central and Premium destinations require explicit deployment mode, fixed database/role/port/hostname and verified CA; the Premium firewall adds only its own database exception.
Premium migration preserves its queue, desktops, identities and earlier preparation database, fences the hosted login, verifies the final copy and installs only the scoped runtime image/config.
Interrupted configuration delivery now writes stdin explicitly and resumes only from recorded accepted phases with exact manifest/config identities; uncertain work is not replayed.
Current relay and migration guides no longer instruct that active Premium execution data resides in Supabase, nor present old closed-gate/zero-account observations as current.
Recovery/export guidance preserves the active native destination and requires compatible images; stale hosted data is not a serving rollback.
Whole-web migration profile preserves necessary production web authority while keeping Nova's narrower profile and general cloud/process credential denials intact.
Isolated fixtures use an authenticated numeric-loopback database bridge rather than weakening the production plaintext destination guard.
Local encrypted recovery preparation is distinct from an uploaded, downloaded and restored off-device archive or authorized irreversible project deletion.
